info.name: Solcast Aggregations Forecast Data API
info.description:
The Solcast API provides live, forecast, historical, and typical meteorological year (TMY) solar irradiance, PV power, and weather data derived from a global fleet of weather satellites. Data covers rooftop PV, advanced PV, grid aggregations, and soiling loss models (Kimber and HSU) globally. Solcast is part of DNV's Green Data Products suite. Authentication uses an API key passed via the Authorization header.

Contact Support:
 Name: Solcast Support

Response format.

request.description: Get irradiance and weather forecasts from the present time up to 14 days ahead for the requested location, derived from satellite observations (nowcasted for approx. 4 hours ahead) and numerical weather models. Data is available at 5- to 60-minute granularity.

response.name: Successful response with forecast irradiance and weather time series.
